name: Tahir Ahmad Bijran
title: Biotechnology • Research • Computational Biology
tagline: Learning biology deeply. Building with technology. Documenting the journey.
bio: I’m an undergraduate Biotechnology student at the Central University of Kashmir, developing an interdisciplinary foundation across molecular biology, nanobiotechnology, computational biology, microbiology and practical laboratory science.
summary: My portfolio brings together academic learning, research exploration, digital projects, scientific communication and the resources I create along the way. I’m interested in understanding biological systems while using computation, visualization and modern digital tools to make scientific work more useful and accessible.
education: Undergraduate studies in Biotechnology with an emphasis on molecular and cellular biology, microbiology, physiology, genetics, plant science and laboratory techniques.
goals: Build a strong interdisciplinary foundation for future research in biotechnology and computational life sciences, while turning academic learning into practical, well-documented work.
